product.title: Private Tour: Rio City Essentials including Christ the Redeemer and Sugar Loaf

description.text: In Rio de Janeiro, this private 7-to-8-hour circuit keeps one group in an air-conditioned vehicle for Christ the Redeemer atop Corcovado, Sugar Loaf Mountain, the Selarón Steps, the Metropolitan Cathedral, and the city's famous beaches. A certified guide and driver handle hotel, airport, or seaport pickup, and complimentary bottled water is listed on the product page. Christ the Redeemer and Sugar Loaf tickets are not treated as a guaranteed inclusion; the operator helps arrange them. The itinerary can change during the day to match the group's pace. Barra da Tijuca and Recreio pickups are asked to start at 6:30 a.m. to avoid heavy traffic. The format suits visitors who want a guided city window without assembling taxi, ticket, and landmark timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Rio de Janeiro, and the itinerary stays on Corcovado, Sugar Loaf, the Selarón Steps, and the Metropolitan Cathedral that define this private outing rather than a Petrópolis mountain add-on.
